## 75% of the applicable advocacy fee in S10

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 75% of the applicable advocacy fee in S10] Trial advocacy fees

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 75% of the applicable advocacy fee in S10] In calculating the number of days, rule 2.8(2) shall not apply and any advocacy fee is to be computed by reference to the following examples. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 75% of the applicable advocacy fee in S10] Examples

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 75% of the applicable advocacy fee in S10] (1)  A claim allocated to the intermediate track is settled not more than 1 day before the date listed for trial. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 75% of the applicable advocacy fee in S10] The trial date is Monday 23 October. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 75% of the applicable advocacy fee in S10] Settlement not more than 1 day before the date listed for trial, means that the claim was settled on or after Friday 20 October, but before Monday 23 October. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 75% of the applicable advocacy fee in S10] (2)  A claim allocated to the intermediate track is settled more than 1 day, but not more than 5 days, before the date listed for trial. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 75% of the applicable advocacy fee in S10] The trial date is Friday 27 October. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 75% of the applicable advocacy fee in S10] Settlement more than 1 day, but not more than 5 days, before the date listed for trial, means that the claim was settled on or after Friday 20 October, but before Thursday 26 October. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 75% of the applicable advocacy fee in S10] (3) A claim allocated to the intermediate track is removed from the list more than 1 day, but not more than 5 days, before the date listed for trial. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 75% of the applicable advocacy fee in S10] The trial date is Thursday 26 October. [PRACTICE DIRECTION 45 – TABLES OF FIXED COSTS (2024) > 75% of the applicable advocacy fee in S10] Removal from the list more than 1 day, but not more than 5 days, before the date listed for trial means that the claim was removed from the list on or after Thursday 19 October, but before Wednesday 25 October. ## TABLE 15: rule 45.53 – amount of fixed costs in claims for noise induced hearing loss
